overview: Computer Engineering combines computer science and electrical engineering to design and develop computing systems, networks and software. It includes computer hardware such as processors, memory and peripheral devices, alongside applications and operating systems.

Computer engineers connect computing systems with other electronic devices and build networks for communication and data transfer. The field also addresses cybersecurity and data privacy, with applications across health care, finance, transportation and other industries.

BIT’s published course structure introduces programming, web technology, databases, digital logic, microprocessors, networking, operating systems, multimedia and information security. Minor and major projects connect these technical areas through practical work.
